releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.39 adds optional on-device barcode linking to Price Photos. All existing product photos, names and prices remain unchanged and continue to work without a barcode. Scan a known barcode to open its product immediately; scan a new barcode to link it to an existing product or create a new product. Each product menu can also add, change or remove its barcode, and product search now accepts either name or barcode.
